title: Silently, in a dream she had come to him after her death, her wasted body within its loose brown graveclothes
html_source: Here Stephen remembers a dream in which he was visited by his mother much like Hamlet (who parallels Stephen in a number of ways) was visited by his father. The Ghost firs tspeaks to Hamlet in 1.5.

anchor.text: Silently, in a dream she had come to him after her death, her wasted body within its loose brown graveclothes
anchor.prefix: d on the jagged granite, leaned his palm against his brow and gazed at the fraying edge of his shiny black coat-sleeve. Pain, that was not yet the pain of love, fretted his heart.
